sources.label: Патчи Morphe для российских Android-приложений
sources.author: RU Apps
patch_list: Bypass anti-tamper
Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.
Bypass RootBeer root detection
Stubs calls into the scottyab/rootbeer native root-checking library so it always reports a clean (non-rooted) result.
Bypass STCrypt CKey root detection
Disables the STCrypt/CKey SDK's aggregate root-detection check so it always reports a clean (non-rooted) result.
Disable analytics libraries
Disables runtime analytics tracking calls and initializers (AppMetrica, MyTracker, Firebase).
Disable analytics manifest components
Disables analytics and tracking components and metadata in AndroidManifest.xml.
Disable AppsFlyer

Disables AppsFlyer attribution/tracking: no-ops its SDK implementation's start() choke point (the actual activation entry point, called directly from app code — not manifest-gated in the v6+ SDK) and disables its install-referrer manifest…
Disable telemetry worker
Stops T-Bank's BaseTelemetryWorker-derived background jobs (disk-buffered OpenTelemetry upload) from doing any work.
Remove TBank ads
Removes TBank stories and promotional surfaces.
